node.name: finding_log_confirmation
node.description: Decide how the inspector responds to the summarised pipeline finding before it is submitted.

conditions.a: The inspector confirms the summarised finding is correct and wants it submitted as shown.
conditions.b: The inspector wants to correct a detail in the summarised finding before it is submitted.
conditions.c: The inspector wants to discard the drafted finding entirely so nothing gets submitted.

ctx: Finding drafted: Segment 14B, km 3.2, coating damage, severity medium, 2 photos attached. Submit this report?
examples.msg: yep all good send it

ctx: Log finding for valve station 7, small corrosion on the flange.
Summary: Valve station 7, flange corrosion, severity low. Shall I submit it?
examples.msg: Please delete this one. I look again and there is nothing, only mud on the flange. No report need.
examples.why: nothing found, wants draft thrown away

ctx: Summary: Segment 22, suspected gas leak, severity high. Submit?
examples.msg: separate thing. excavation permit seg 22 thursday. who issues

ctx: Record a finding: dent on the pipe at marker 41, about 4 mm deep.
Summary: Marker 41, dent, depth 4 mm, severity medium. Confirm submission?
examples.msg: That's all correct, go ahead and file it. By the way, the access gate at marker 40 is broken again, someone should look at it.
examples.why: confirms as is; correction option would be wrong

ctx: Finding drafted: Segment 9, km 12.5, missing cathodic protection reading, severity low. Submit?
examples.msg: Sorry, I think I might have mixed something up, I was actually standing much further along, near the 15 km post I believe. I really don't want the wrong spot going in.
examples.why: location in summary is wrong, needs fixing

node.name: charging_support_router
node.description: Decide which support request a driver or site host is making to the charging network.

conditions.a: Driver reports a charger that is physically broken or offline at a station, for example a dark screen, damaged cable, or connector that does not respond.
conditions.b: Driver disputes a specific charge on their bill or receipt, such as being billed for energy not received or a duplicated session fee.
conditions.c: Driver asks how pricing works in general, for example per-kWh rates, idle fees or membership discounts, without contesting any specific past charge.
conditions.d: Driver wants to cancel or pause their charging membership plan, including stopping the automatic monthly renewal; not about one-off session payments.
conditions.e: Site host business asks about its revenue share payouts, host dashboard reports, or adding more chargers at the property it hosts.

ctx: Hello, I use your station at the mall since last month.
Thanks for using our network! Are you asking about the price per kWh, or about the extra fee when a car stays plugged in after charging finishes?
examples.msg: The second thing. How it is calculated?
examples.why: asks how idle fee works, via context

examples.msg: yo y'all hit me twice for the same freaking session last night, that's straight crap, I want my money back
examples.why: disputes duplicate charge; general pricing would be wrong

examples.msg: ain't tryna ditch you guys for good or nothin, just wanna put the monthly thing on ice while I'm abroad for a couple months

ctx: Hi, welcome to support. How can I help today?
examples.msg: I have the hotel with four of your chargers in our parking. This month the money transfer to us is much smaller than before and I don't see why.
My receipt say 40 kWh but my car battery only take maybe 15. Please check this and give back the money.

node.name: pass_answer_followup
node.description: Decide how the operator reacts after the assistant answered a question about a satellite pass.

conditions.a: Operator accepts the answer and is satisfied, for example thanks the assistant or says the pass information resolves the question, with no further request.
conditions.b: Operator wants more detail on the same answer, such as exact acquisition and loss of signal times, elevation profile or antenna setup for that pass.
conditions.c: Operator says the given answer is wrong or does not match their own data, for example a different pass time, wrong satellite or mismatched frequency.

ctx: The next pass of ORION-3 over Station North is tomorrow at 04:12 UTC, maximum elevation 62 degrees. Anything else?
examples.msg: Great, that's exactly what I needed. Thanks.

ctx: Your pass with the weather satellite on Thursday is confirmed for dish 2 in the 14:30 UTC window.
examples.msg: Could you please provide the maximum elevation and the precise start and end times of contact for that window?
examples.why: asks for more detail on same pass

ctx: when's our next pass for the relay bird KESTREL-7
KESTREL-7's next pass is at 09:45 UTC with downlink on 2245 MHz.
examples.msg: that's not even close, our tracking sheet says 10:20 and the downlink is 2260, damn it. and the coffee machine in the ops room is dead again
examples.why: says answer is wrong; coffee is side topic

ctx: LYNX-2 rises at 21:05 UTC over Station South, maximum elevation 40 degrees.
examples.msg: tracked it last night. rise 21:40 not 21:05. elevation barely 20

ctx: Can you check when we have the ORCA-1 pass on Saturday?
ORCA-1 passes over Station East on Saturday from roughly 13:00 UTC, at a high elevation.
examples.msg: Hmm, 'roughly' and 'high' won't quite cut it when I'm writing the antenna pointing plan for the weekend crew.
examples.why: wants precise detail, not disputing correctness

node.name: agency_inbound_router
node.description: Route an inbound message to the right translation agency workflow.

conditions.a: New TR job intake: client sends docs for quote/translation (src+tgt lang, deadline)
conditions.b: Status chk on in-progress TR job by job ref / delivery ETA
conditions.c: QA complaint re delivered TR: mistranslation, terminology errors, rework req
conditions.d: Freelance linguist onboarding: translator applying to join vendor pool

examples.msg: Good afternoon, I do hope you are keeping well. Your agency kindly translated my late father's will last spring, and now our accountant has asked me for a duplicate of the invoice showing your VAT number, for the estate records. Might you be able to send me a copy? Thank you so very much for your help.
examples.why: wants a duplicate invoice, no route covers it

examples.msg: I've been translating Portuguese medical texts as a freelancer for about six years and I'm not sure if you even work with outside people... sorry if this is the wrong place to ask.
examples.why: translator hinting at joining the pool

ctx: Hi! Would you like to send us a new document, or check on one we're already working on?
examples.msg: 2nd. ref 4471
The German manual you sent back calls our torque wrench a 'turning key' on every single page. This is useless. Fix it.
examples.why: complains about wrong terms in delivered work

ctx: Hi, quick question first, are you open on Saturdays?
We're closed at weekends, but the portal accepts uploads anytime. What can I do for you?
examples.msg: OK, shame about Saturdays. I've got three contracts in Spanish that need to be in English by the 30th, what would that cost? Also your portal logged me out twice today.
examples.why: new job quote; portal issue is secondary

node.name: outreach_request_router
node.description: Decide what a school or member of the public wants from the space agency outreach team.

conditions.a: Is the user asking to book a school or group visit to the visitor centre?
conditions.b: Is the user requesting an astronaut or scientist speaker to come to their school or event?
conditions.c: Is the user asking about visitor centre opening hours or tickets for an individual or family visit?
conditions.d: Is the user asking about a current or upcoming mission, such as launch dates or objectives?

ctx: Sounds great! How can the outreach team help with your science week?
examples.msg: not coming to you. want someone from you to come talk to the kids
examples.why: wants a speaker at school, not a visit

ctx: Hello! Are you looking to bring a class to our visitor centre, or to have one of our speakers come to you?
examples.msg: The first one, for about 25 kids in May.

ctx: Hi there, what can we do for you today?
examples.msg: yo our rocket club ain't got the cash to bus everybody out to y'all, so could one of your astronaut folks swing by and hype the kids up? would be freaking epic
examples.why: can't travel, wants astronaut to come

ctx: Hi! Planning a visit? Are you coming as a school group, or just yourself or with family?
examples.msg: just me and dad. open sat?
I'd like to arrange a trip to your visitor centre for my Year 6 class of 30 pupils next term.
examples.why: class visit booking; individual tickets would be wrong

ctx: your website is a mess, I can't find anything
Sorry about that! Which are you after: visiting us, a speaker, or news on the lunar lander mission?
examples.msg: The last one, obviously. Has the date slipped again or what?
examples.why: picks mission news, asks about launch date

node.name: troop_admin_router
node.description: Decide which troop administration task the scout leader needs help with.

conditions.a: Leader wants to register scouts for an upcoming camp or trip, including adding names, paying the camp fee, or asking whether places remain.
conditions.b: Leader asks about badge requirements or wants to record that a scout completed a badge, such as first aid or knot tying.
conditions.c: Leader needs a parent consent or medical form, for example getting a blank form or checking whether a family has returned theirs.
conditions.d: Leader wants to withdraw a scout from an already booked camp or trip, including asking about a refund of the camp fee.
conditions.e: Leader asks about borrowing troop equipment such as tents, stoves or canoes for a meeting or outing.
conditions.f: Leader reports a safety incident or injury that happened during a troop activity and needs to file a report.

ctx: Hi! What can I help with today?
examples.msg: best pizza place open late downtown
examples.why: restaurant question, unrelated to troop admin

examples.msg: Great, another Saturday ruined. One of my kids slipped on the wet rocks during the river hike and split his chin open, we spent three hours at urgent care.

ctx: question about Maya in my patrol
examples.msg: finished all fire safety badge stuff last wk. mark done
We go on fishing day in June, can the troop give us two canoes and the paddles for this day?
yo got like five more kiddos dying to hit the summer lake camp, any spots left or are we screwed?
examples.why: sign up more scouts, asks about places

node.name: pass_office_router
node.description: Route a request to the correct base pass office workflow.

conditions.a: Visitor pass req: sponsor requests 1-day/short-term pass for guest w/o base ID
conditions.c: Contractor badge renewal: extend expiring long-term contractor pass
conditions.d: App status chk: follow-up on already submitted visitor/contractor pass app

ctx: Good morning. I submitted a visitor pass application for my father last Tuesday.
Good morning. How may I assist you regarding that application?
examples.msg: I would like to know whether it has been approved yet, as he is due to arrive on Friday.

ctx: hi I sent in some paperwork so my brother-in-law can get on the base, the guest thing?
Got it. Do you want to submit a new request, or check on the one you already sent?
examples.msg: uh the one I already sent, I think?
Sorry if this is the wrong office, but I think I need to register my car to drive onto the base? I'm worried I'll get turned away at the gate without the sticker.
examples.why: vehicle registration, not a pass route

ctx: Pass office, what do you need?
examples.msg: hey so it's not a renewal or anything, my buddy's just visiting Saturday and needs to get in for the day.
examples.why: day pass for a guest, not renewal

ctx: Welcome to the pass office. How can I help?
examples.msg: I went jogging this morning and when I got home the plastic card I use to get through the gate wasn't in my pocket anymore.
My contractor badge expires at the end of the month and our project runs until next spring. How do I get it extended?

node.name: studio_request_router
node.description: Decide what a podcaster wants from the recording studio.

conditions.a: Is the user asking to book a new recording session in one of the studios?
conditions.b: Is the user asking to reschedule an existing session booking to another time?
conditions.c: Is the user asking for editing or post-production work on recorded episodes?
conditions.d: Is the user asking about prices or packages for studio time or editing?

ctx: Hi, thanks for contacting the studio. How can I help?
examples.msg: My co-host just found out she has jury duty on Thursday, which is exactly when we're booked in Studio B.
we recorded four episodes and I have zero time to cut out all the ums and dead air myself, can you do it or not
so I've got like 200 bucks for this whole podcast thing, what would that even get me?
I think I might have left my headphones and a notebook in the green room after Tuesday's session, sorry, is there any chance someone found them?

ctx: Hello! What can we do for you?
examples.msg: Need a 3-hr block Wednesday afternoon, two dynamic mics, multitrack to separate channels at 48k/24-bit.

ctx: Would you like to book a session right away, or would you prefer to see our rates first?
examples.msg: The latter, if you would be so kind.

node.name: session_booking_confirmation
node.description: Decide how the client responds to the summarised studio session booking.

conditions.a: The client confirms the summarised session booking and wants it finalised as shown.
conditions.b: The client wants to change a detail of the booking, such as day, hours or engineer.
conditions.c: The client wants to cancel the booking request entirely instead of confirming it.

ctx: Booking summary: Room 2, Saturday 10:00-18:00, tracking with engineer Dana, analog console, tape machine. Shall I lock this in?
examples.msg: Copy, that's the session.

ctx: I would like to book the mastering suite for Friday afternoon.
Summary: mastering suite, Friday 13:00-17:00, engineer Ravi. Would you like to confirm, change, or cancel?
examples.msg: The last of those, please.

ctx: Here's your booking: Live Room, Tuesday 14:00-20:00, mixing with engineer Kai. Should I confirm it?
examples.msg: Hmm, Thursday would work better for us.

ctx: Summary: Room 1, Monday 09:00-13:00, vocal tracking with engineer Lu. Confirm?
examples.msg: scrap it. singer quit. dont need room at all
examples.why: cancel entirely; changing booking would be wrong

ctx: book me for mixing next week please
Booking: Mix Room, Wednesday 10:00-16:00, engineer Pat. Confirm?
examples.msg: Close, but can we have Jo instead of Pat? Pat mixed our last EP way too loud. Also is parking still free behind the building?
examples.why: swap engineer; parking is side question

ctx: Hello, I'd like to book a mastering session for my daughter's choir recording.
Summary: mastering suite, Saturday 11:00-13:00, engineer Sam. Shall I confirm?
examples.msg: Oh, that's very kind of you, thank you. The thing is, Saturday morning is when the choir rehearses, and I promised my daughter I would drive her and two of her friends there, so would it at all be possible to make it Saturday afternoon instead, say around three? Two hours would still be perfect. Thank you ever so much for your patience.
examples.why: wants time changed; cancel would be wrong

node.name: practice_enquiry_router
node.description: Decide what an incoming enquiry to the architecture practice is about.

conditions.a: The prospective client wants to discuss a new building or renovation project with the practice.
conditions.b: The client asks about progress or schedule of the design work on their ongoing project.
conditions.c: A planning authority officer requests documents or clarification on a submitted planning application.
conditions.d: The visitor asks about job openings or internships at the architecture practice.
conditions.e: The client wants to change the design or scope of their ongoing project.

examples.msg: our kitchen extension design. want skylight added + back wall moved 1m. still doable
yo I'm wrapping up my archi degree and I'd freaking love a summer gig at y'all's office, you hiring or nah?
We'd like to add a third bedroom to the house design you're working on for us; the family is growing.
examples.why: change ongoing design; progress query would be wrong

examples.msg: I am from city planning office. We don't receive the drainage drawings for the application on Elm Road, please send them, without them we cannot continue.
so it's been like six weeks since we signed off the sketches for our cabin and we haven't heard a peep
examples.why: implicitly asks where the work stands
